item: withdrawn asks (1.28): a control_cancel_request retires the live card as withdrawn, and a late answer for that id goes nowhere
branch: ClaudeCli.route → onCancel → ClaudeSessionService drops pendingPermissions/pendingSuggestions → ChatPanel pushes __perm_cancelled {id} and dismisses the editor diff; 70-events.js: an AskUserQuestion card resolves through resolveAsk, any other card through permCards[id].lapse() (85-cards.js) — buttons gone, feedback field gone, contenteditable command frozen, plan separator gone, '✗ Withdrawn — Claude stopped waiting' on the decision line; the permCards entry is deleted so __perm_answered for the same id is a no-op
provenance: The CLI frame is MEASURED 2026-09-05 over stdio on 2.1.261 with the panel's flags (scratchpad probe_banners.py --on-ask park --interrupt-after 12): a parked Bash can_use_tool (request_id 5529cc5c-…) followed by an interrupt produced, in order, control_cancel_request{request_id:5529cc5c-…} → control_response to the interrupt → user tool_result 'The user doesn't want to proceed with this tool use…' → user text '[Request interrupted by user for tool use]' → result{subtype:error_during_execution, is_error:true, terminal_reason:aborted_tools, permission_denials:[…]}. The binary (2.1.261) also writes the frame on shutdown with a parked question, on resume of a stale parked prompt from a prior worker, and when a hook answer supersedes a parked hook_callback; the schema text: 'Tells the other side that the sender no longer needs the answer to one of its own in-flight control_requests'. Before this row the frame reached the webview raw through ClaudeCli.route's else-branch and fell through the event switch unhandled; Kotlin kept the pending entry (respondPermission would still have refused a late answer, so the harm was the card LOOKING answerable). `__perm_cancelled` and `permission_request` are OUR frames (ChatPanel's shapes, fixture 11) — self-consistency for the page half; the Kotlin chain is proven by compileKotlin and the live hand test (§17 MT-1.28). NEGATIVE CONTROL: run against the sandbox still serving the pre-change webview — RUN 2026-09-05 (sandbox launched before the JS edit, fixture written first): 13 FAILED / 2 passed / 0 aborts; the two passes are GUARDs (the unknown-id no-throw step and the plan body surviving) that hold on both builds. After the edit, compileKotlin, `./gradlew test` 160 and a sandbox restart: 15/15; full harness 755/0 (740 + 15).
